name: designer
description: Designer workbench for code-first design/UX decision & quality assurance across Claude Code & Codex CLI (ADR-0042). The third L3 persona after engineer and founder: the six universal cognitive verbs (investigate / frame / decide / compose / critique / refine) re-anchored to UX/UI/CTA/flow — pre-code design thinking (user flows, wireframe specs, CTA copy, information architecture) plus a post-code quality-critique loop that evaluates rendered screenshots + frontend code under usability / accessibility / conversion / consistency lenses. Composes the image L2 capability for generated imagery rather than re-implementing it; Figma and external design tools are excluded in v1 (code-first scope). Incubating scaffold — the persona's remaining surfaces (the start lifecycle macro and the resume / checkpoint / peer-now meta skills) land across the ADR-0042 implementation ladder; this release completes the six-verb cognitive set by adding refine (the critique → refine → re-critique convergence loop — applies critique findings or feedback to a design spec or the frontend code + rendered screen, single-mode, verifying the design still reconciles and never clears a usability/conversion problem by opening a new accessibility barrier) on top of the earlier critique (host-direct vision quality lenses over a pre-code design spec or a post-code rendered screenshot + frontend code — usability / accessibility / conversion / consistency, accessibility a candidate-only veto gate, every review held to a single internalized quality-criteria reference), decide (a 7-axis design/UX decision registry — usability + an archetype axis decisive, accessibility a veto gate), compose (user flows, wireframe specs, CTA copy, information architecture, and component specs each annotated with accessibility + consistency acceptance criteria), investigate (cited design brief), and frame (UX problem model with measurable success metrics) surfaces, the scaffold, catalogs, release wiring, staged shape test, and the copy-trimmed non-dispatch workflow-continuity machinery and hooks.
